name: Pretty Epic Tower Defense [APRIL2026 + MODIFIERS]
desc:
A Tower Defense Insane Asylum optimized to give society's most deranged a difficult tower defense experience

Welcome to our purgatory. You aren't expected to survive, none of us are.

Our gimmick? The parry system... and extreme difficulty, of course.

A TD / Tower Defense strategy game, play multiple difficulties, buy tons of towers, and fight challenging bosses. There are many secrets to find! But I wouldn't trust bolster, he seems a bit off...

Survive and defend the research facility from waves of invading monsters using different towers in battle, both Human and Noob species with different strategies, including challenging bosses to defending it like your search history against the strongest being alive!

Defeat the king of an alternate reversed dimension where mutated insect monsters roam, swordfight the reaper turned devil of planet Earth, or dig up lore behind towers.

|| THIS GAME IS FOR ADVANCED TOWER DEFENSE PLAYERS ||

PETD is completely human-made and will never use AI
